lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately three horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance that intersect the horizontal rows of spots and carinae, creating a discernible but low-contrast grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-contrast gradient with specular highlights on the upper boundary and deep shadows on the lower boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin displays a distinct pattern of vertical light-intensity striations and a sparse distribution of high-luminance spots on the superior lobe.
